About CWS

An apparel sourcing partner built on dependable manufacturing connections

Cross Weave Sourcing (CWS) is an apparel manufacturing and global sourcing company established to connect international fashion brands, retailers and importers with dependable manufacturing partners in Bangladesh.

With business presence in the United States and a sourcing and production network in Bangladesh, CWS supports clients from product development and sampling through bulk manufacturing, quality coordination and shipment planning — one coordinated point of contact across the whole order.

  • Buyer-first coordination — product, quality, cost and delivery expectations understood up front.
  • Factory matching — suppliers matched by product category, order size and buyer requirements.
  • Clear communication — order status updates from sampling to shipment readiness.

Our Mission

To help apparel brands grow through reliable production, competitive sourcing, consistent quality and responsive service.

Our Vision

To become a trusted global sourcing partner recognized for dependable manufacturing connections, transparent business practices and long-term client relationships.

Our Core Values

  • Customer focusUnderstand each buyer's product, quality, cost and delivery expectations.
  • Integrity & transparencyCommunicate clearly and build relationships based on trust.
  • Quality commitmentCoordinate quality checks throughout product development and production.
  • ResponsibilityPromote responsible sourcing and work with factories that meet buyer requirements.
  • Long-term partnershipBuild sustainable relationships with buyers, suppliers and manufacturing partners.
What we do

Our Services

Coordinated sourcing and production support tailored to the needs of apparel brands, importers and retailers.

Product Development & Sampling

Support with product concepts, specifications, sample coordination and revisions.

Private Label Manufacturing

Fabric & Trim Sourcing

Costing & Commercial Support

Quality Control & Inspection

Export Documentation & Logistics

Bulk Production

Manufacturing network & quality

Coordinated production, checked at every stage

CWS works with a network of apparel manufacturers and suppliers in Bangladesh to support different product categories, production requirements and order sizes.

  • Factory and supplier matching based on product category and buyer requirements
  • Production planning and follow-up
  • Sample, fabric and trim coordination
  • Order status communication and shipment readiness

Quality assurance approach

Quality activities are coordinated according to the buyer's quality manual and inspection requirements — from material checks through to corrective-action follow-up.

1Material Checks

Fabric and trims reviewed before production begins.

2Pre-Production Review

Approved sample, specs and plan confirmed with the factory.

3In-Line Inspection

Checks during production to catch issues early.

4Final Inspection

Finished goods inspected against buyer requirements before shipment.

5Corrective Action

Findings followed up and resolved with the manufacturing partner.

Compliance note: Factory social and environmental compliance status is verified for each nominated manufacturing partner. BSCI, SEDEX and WRAP are examples of standards or audit programs that may be relevant depending on the factory and buyer requirements — CWS does not claim these certifications as its own.
